description: Home hero: concurrent tracks handling ambient sway, blink, CTA hover scale, and decoupled belly proximity eye-tracking.

Hover.notes: Driven externally by HTML #home-lets-play-btn hover/focus events or internally by Rive listeners to drive CTA scale pop.

Eye_Look_Position.notes: Driven completely natively inside Rive by the Button and Belly hit targets. Retained as an exposed value for potential code-level debugging. Do NOT write from HTML.

button.notes: Rive Button/Belly listeners drive Hover + Eye_Look_Position natively. HTML pointerenter/leave and focus/blur may also set Hover=true/false for accessibility when the HTML hit rect is used; do NOT set Eye_Look_Position from HTML.

hit_targets.name: Button
hit_targets.purpose: CTA touch bounds. Fires Hover=true/false and Eye_Look_Position=100/0. Overlays Belly shape to prioritize click execution.

hit_targets.name: Belly
hit_targets.purpose: Expands proximity touch radius over Puffly's entire white fur stomach. Natively fires Belly Poke (Eye_Look_Position=100) and Belly UnPoke (Eye_Look_Position=0 / Hover=false backup reset).

layers.purpose: Low-velocity organic looping body pendulum sway from the beam

wiring.html_hover_to_rive: pointerenter/focus → Hover=true; pointerleave/blur → Hover=false. Eye look-down is fully automated by Rive Button/Belly targets — do not set Eye_Look_Position from HTML.
wiring.rive_listeners: Enable Rive listeners (shouldDisableRiveListeners=false) so Button/Belly hit targets receive pointer events.
wiring.pointer_events: Allow pointer events on the Rive canvas host so Belly can be poked outside the HTML CTA rect. Keep #home-lets-play-btn above the canvas for click ownership.
wiring.reduced_motion: If prefers-reduced-motion media query is active, bypass Rive canvas completely and swap for static fallback PNG.
